name: value-utilities/svg-fill-stroke
description: SVG `fill` and `stroke` utilities. Color forms (`fill-red-500`, `stroke-current`) use the raw-value path with no `--tw-*-opacity` indirection (mirror upstream's `toColorValue` route). `stroke-<width>` is a numeric scale (`stroke-0/1/2`) on `stroke-width`. `fill-none` and `stroke-none` are static reset keywords.
